title: CleanSlate: Messy Data Sanitizer & JSON/CSV Structurer
target_pain: Manually cleaning messy scraped data, fixing broken JSON/CSV, removing duplicates, and filtering out corrupted or placeholder rows.
key_features: Auto-detects input format (JSON, CSV, TSV, or raw lines)
Advanced deduplication with custom key matching
Deep sanitization: strips HTML, normalizes whitespace, fixes broken quotes
Anomalous/Fake data detector (flags placeholders, invalid emails, empty fields)
Instant export to perfectly formatted JSON or CSV
